summary: This Form 8-K by BMO 2023-C7 Mortgage Trust (issuing entity) and BMO Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC (depositor) reports a routine servicing agreement update under Item 8.01. Effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC replaced Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for the BANK5 2023-5YR3 pool, which includes the 11 West 42nd Street mortgage loan held by the trust. The filing attaches the Assignment and Assumption Agreement (special servicing). No transaction, pricing, or shareholder action is involved. It is an administrative notification of a servicer succession, not a special situation. Watch for operational continuity but no investment implications.
